To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

serum trefoil factor 1 (TFF1), TFF2, TFF3 and the ratio of pepsinogen I to pepsinogen II were measured in 1,000 patients with gastric cancer, 1,000 healthy controls, 1,500 with chronic atrophic gastrititis, 1,100 with chronic non-atrophic gastricitis and 100 with Helicobacter Pylori infection.

serum trefoil factor 1, trefoil factor 2 and trefoil factor 5 levels in the control groups are significantly lower than those of the gastric cancer group except for trefoil factor 4, and trefoil factor is a better predictor of cancer than the pepsinogens.
the TFF3 serum level is a potential biomarker for gastric carcinoma screening.
